metadata.audit_title: Durable Job Orchestration & Adversarial Reliability Discrepancy Register

discrepancies.finding: Throughput remains strictly bounded at ~2.73 - 2.91 req/s across C1, C2, C4, and C8 concurrency.
discrepancies.root_cause: PyTorch MPS backend on Apple Silicon does not support multi-stream concurrent kernel launches for heavy neural / mesh processing. The staging worker enforces engine_lock, causing concurrent client requests to queue cleanly rather than executing in parallel.
discrepancies.resolution: Document truthful scaling characteristics: concurrency increases queue wait time linearly while preventing MPS out-of-memory crashes. Production scaling requires horizontal worker processes.
discrepancies.impact: Low (Expected architectural reality; no crashes, zero data loss, 100% success rate across C1-C8).

discrepancies.finding: Late cancellation requests received after job completion could theoretically overwrite COMPLETED state if unvalidated.
discrepancies.root_cause: Prior worker implementation checked job['status'] in ('queued', 'processing') without guarding against terminal state mutations.
discrepancies.resolution: Implemented VALID_TRANSITIONS formal state machine in staging_worker.py: terminal states (COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT) are immutable.
discrepancies.impact: Resolved (Verified by test DUR-14-13-03 and Point 8 cancellation testing).

discrepancies.finding: Jobs in-flight during an ungraceful process crash or SIGKILL previously remained stuck in RUNNING state upon restart.
discrepancies.root_cause: Rehydration simply read JSON files into memory without auditing in-flight timestamps or worker process restart events.
discrepancies.resolution: Enhanced rehydrate_jobs_from_disk() to automatically transition in-flight QUEUED/RUNNING jobs to FAILED on startup.
discrepancies.impact: Resolved (Verified by test DUR-14-13-06 and 7-stage crash benchmark).

discrepancies.finding: Simulated I/O interrupts during GLB or JSON writing left dangling temporary files on disk.
discrepancies.root_cause: Direct file writes risk leaving zero-byte or partially written files if process exits mid-write.
discrepancies.resolution: Enforced atomic tempfile + os.replace() write pattern with fsync and automatic startup pruning of .tmp_* files.

discrepancies.finding: Remote NVIDIA CUDA cluster remains non-operational in current execution environment.
discrepancies.root_cause: Physical host is Apple Silicon (arm64 Apple M2); no NVIDIA hardware or paid cloud GPUs provisioned without user authorization.
discrepancies.resolution: Truthful provenance reporting: EXEC_ENVIRONMENT = local_mps_development, CLOUD_CUDA_STATUS = BLOCKED.
discrepancies.impact: Acknowledged and transparently reported across all reports and worker health endpoints.

discrepancies.finding: Worker process RSS grows from ~250MB baseline to ~330MB during first 100 requests, then plateaus.
discrepancies.root_cause: PyTorch MPS unified memory allocator retains internal buffers for recurring tensor operations rather than freeing to OS on each forward pass.
discrepancies.resolution: Regular gc.collect() and torch.mps.empty_cache() prevent unbounded growth; memory slope is -0.038 MB/100 requests after warmup across 1,000 requests.
discrepancies.impact: Resolved (Verified across 1,000 sequential requests in PHASE_14_13_MEMORY_STABILITY.json).

discrepancies.finding: Executive report claimed P50: 428.6ms, P95: 578.9ms whereas detailed technical report recorded P50: 338.0ms, P95: 363.3ms.
discrepancies.root_cause: Run A (Executive) evaluated un-warmed client HTTP socket roundtrip latency across multi-category diverse garments with higher vertex counts. Run B (Technical) evaluated warm steady-state loopback latency on standardized reference bodycon dress geometry.
discrepancies.resolution: Reconciled both runs in PHASE_14_13_BENCHMARK_RECONCILIATION.json with full boundary, dataset, and percentile accounting without merging.

discrepancies.category: Cloud Cost Estimation vs Actual Invoices
discrepancies.finding: Cloud cost model documents $727.87/mo ($0.00728/reconstruction at 100k volume) while actual cloud billing is $0.00.
discrepancies.root_cause: The $727.87 figure is an engineering financial projection based on published GCP L4 spot pricing. No paid cloud resources have been provisioned.
discrepancies.resolution: Reconciled in PHASE_14_13_CLOUD_COST_RECONCILIATION.json, explicitly noting actual invoices = $0.00.
